commands:
set -euo pipefail
PIN=d4a7310019a9157535536c471967ae3358511823
EXPECTED=f8d654a8809802805c4fce869fee4ea3b554adb327f9e710b7d1dcbc47ea7f1a
git fetch origin main plot-inbox
git reset --hard origin/main
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
cd projects/kobra2-neo
uv sync --frozen >/dev/null
BASE=/tmp/kobra-portrait-final-20260929-61
rm -rf "$BASE"
mkdir -p "$BASE/job"
git show "$PIN":projects/kobra2-neo/inbox/current.svg > "$BASE/job/source.svg"
SOURCE_SHA=$(shasum -a 256 "$BASE/job/source.svg" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$SOURCE_SHA" = "$EXPECTED"
.venv/bin/python - "$BASE/job" "$EXPECTED" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, math, sys, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import kobra_plot as kp

job = Path(sys.argv[1])
expected = sys.argv[2]
src = job / "source.svg"
raw = src.read_bytes()
actual = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
if actual != expected:
    raise SystemExit(f"source SHA mismatch: {actual}")

root = ET.parse(src).getroot()
if root.attrib.get("width") != "150.0mm" or root.attrib.get("height") != "150.0mm":
    raise SystemExit(f"source is not declared 150x150 mm: width={root.attrib.get('width')} height={root.attrib.get('height')}")
view = [float(x) for x in root.attrib.get("viewBox", "").replace(",", " ").split()]
if view != [0.0, 0.0, 150.0, 150.0]:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected viewBox: {view}")

kp.preflight_svg_source(src)
lines = kp.load_normalized_svg(src)
if len(lines) != 6587:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected path count: {len(lines)}")
point_count = sum(len(line) for line in lines)
if point_count != 87063:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected point count: {point_count}")

b0 = kp.bounds(lines)
eps = 1e-9
if not (-eps <= b0.min_x <= b0.max_x <= 150.0 + eps and -eps <= b0.min_y <= b0.max_y <= 150.0 + eps):
    raise SystemExit(f"source geometry outside 150mm page: {b0}")

original_ids = {id(line) for line in lines}
bucket_mm = 5.0
ordered = sorted(
    lines,
    key=lambda line: (
        int(line[0][1] // bucket_mm),
        line[0][0] if int(line[0][1] // bucket_mm) % 2 == 0 else -line[0][0],
    ),
)
if {id(line) for line in ordered} != original_ids or len(ordered) != len(lines):
    raise SystemExit("path-order preservation invariant failed")
if sum(len(line) for line in ordered) != point_count:
    raise SystemExit("point-count preservation invariant failed")

profile = kp.load_profile()
if profile.orientation.swap_xy or profile.orientation.flip_x or not profile.orientation.flip_y:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected orientation profile: {profile.orientation}")

page = 150.0
ox = profile.workspace.draw_min_x + ((profile.workspace.draw_max_x - profile.workspace.draw_min_x) - page) / 2.0
oy = profile.workspace.draw_min_y + ((profile.workspace.draw_max_y - profile.workspace.draw_min_y) - page) / 2.0
if not (math.isclose(ox, 38.0, abs_tol=1e-9) and math.isclose(oy, 58.0, abs_tol=1e-9)):
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected 150mm centered origin: {(ox, oy)}")

mapped = []
for line in ordered:
    out = []
    for x, y in line:
        out.append((ox + x, oy + (page - y)))
    mapped.append(out)

b = kp.bounds(mapped)
ws = profile.workspace
if not (ws.draw_min_x <= b.min_x <= b.max_x <= ws.draw_max_x and ws.draw_min_y <= b.min_y <= b.max_y <= ws.draw_max_y):
    raise SystemExit(f"unsafe mapped bounds: {b}")

out = [
    "; kobra-plot exact-final-svg job",
    f"; source_sha256={actual}",
    "; geometry_policy=no-vectorize,no-simplify,no-merge,no-reverse,path-order-only",
    f"; source_page_mm=150x150 origin_mm={ox:.3f},{oy:.3f}",
    "G90",
    f"G0 Z{profile.tool.pen_up_z:.2f} F{profile.motion.z_feed:.0f}",
]
for line in mapped:
    sx, sy = line[0]
    out.append(f"G0 X{sx:.3f} Y{sy:.3f} F{profile.motion.travel_feed:.0f}")
    out.append(f"G0 Z{profile.tool.pen_down_z:.2f} F{profile.motion.z_feed:.0f}")
    for x, y in line[1:]:
        out.append(f"G1 X{x:.3f} Y{y:.3f} F{profile.motion.draw_feed:.0f}")
    out.append(f"G0 Z{profile.tool.pen_up_z:.2f} F{profile.motion.z_feed:.0f}")
out.extend(profile.end_commands)
gcode = "\n".join(out) + "\n"
safety = kp.validate_gcode(gcode, profile)

gpath = job / "output.gcode"
ppath = job / "preview.svg"
rpath = job / "report.json"
gpath.write_text(gcode, encoding="utf-8")
ppath.write_text(kp.render_preview(mapped, profile), encoding="utf-8")

stats = kp.geometry_stats(mapped, profile)
stats["input_bounds"] = b0.as_dict()
stats["output_bounds"] = b.as_dict()
stats["source_polylines"] = len(lines)
stats["source_points"] = point_count
stats["geometry_preserved"] = True
stats["path_reversal"] = False
stats["path_merge"] = False
stats["path_simplification"] = False
stats["path_reordering"] = "5mm-y-bucket-snake-whole-path-only"
if stats["nominal_time_seconds"] >= 6600:
    raise SystemExit(f"prepared job nominal time too close to live command timeout: {stats['nominal_time_seconds']} s")

report = {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "title": "Exact final portrait SVG 150x150mm",
    "bounds_mm": {
        "min_x": round(b.min_x, 3), "max_x": round(b.max_x, 3),
        "min_y": round(b.min_y, 3), "max_y": round(b.max_y, 3),
    },
    "source": {
        "filename": "source.svg",
        "sha256": actual,
        "bytes": len(raw),
        "page_mm": [150.0, 150.0],
        "machine_page_origin_mm": [ox, oy],
        "conversion": "none",
    },
    "geometry": stats,
    "profile": {
        "name": profile.name,
        "pen_up_z": profile.tool.pen_up_z,
        "pen_down_z": profile.tool.pen_down_z,
        "motion": {
            "travel_feed": profile.motion.travel_feed,
            "draw_feed": profile.motion.draw_feed,
            "z_feed": profile.motion.z_feed,
        },
        "orientation": {
            "swap_xy": profile.orientation.swap_xy,
            "flip_x": profile.orientation.flip_x,
            "flip_y": profile.orientation.flip_y,
        },
    },
    "safety": safety,
    "artifacts": {},
}
report["artifacts"]["gcode_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(gcode.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
report["artifacts"]["preview_svg_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(ppath.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
rpath.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

print("EXACT_GEOMETRY", json.dumps({
    "polylines": len(lines),
    "points": point_count,
    "input_bounds": b0.as_dict(),
    "output_bounds": b.as_dict(),
    "nominal_time_seconds": stats["nominal_time_seconds"],
    "travel_distance_mm": stats["travel_distance_mm"],
}, sort_keys=True))
print("SOURCE_SHA256", actual)
print("GCODE_SHA256", report["artifacts"]["gcode_sha256"])
PY
GCODE_SHA=$(python3 - "$BASE/job/report.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
assert r["source"]["sha256"] == "f8d654a8809802805c4fce869fee4ea3b554adb327f9e710b7d1dcbc47ea7f1a"
assert r["source"]["conversion"] == "none"
assert r["geometry"]["geometry_preserved"] is True
assert r["geometry"]["path_simplification"] is False
assert r["geometry"]["path_merge"] is False
assert r["geometry"]["path_reversal"] is False
assert r["geometry"]["source_polylines"] == 6587
assert r["geometry"]["source_points"] == 87063
assert r["safety"]["valid"] is True
p=r["profile"]
assert p["pen_up_z"] == 4.97 and p["pen_down_z"] == 2.97
assert p["motion"]["travel_feed"] == 6000.0
assert p["motion"]["draw_feed"] == 2400.0
assert p["motion"]["z_feed"] == 360.0
print(r["artifacts"]["gcode_sha256"])
PY
)
.venv/bin/kobra-live "$BASE/job/output.gcode" --report "$BASE/job/report.json" --profile config/kobra2_neo_pen.toml --expect-sha256 "$GCODE_SHA" --validate-only
echo PREFLIGHT_OK
echo RESULT:READY_TO_PRINT job=$BASE/job source_commit=$PIN source_sha256=$SOURCE_SHA gcode_sha256=$GCODE_SHA
